Public Function rptVarianceRatio(ByVal host As ITemplateHost, ByVal parameters As ParameterBag) As ParameterBag Dim P As Double, f As Double Dim bot As Integer, top As Integer Dim mean() As Double, ss() As Double, var() As Double, sd() As Double, sem() As Double Dim tnx() As Integer
ReDim mean(1), ss(1), var(1), sd(1), sem(1), tnx(1) Dim data As DataFrame = parameters("data").AsDataFrame para(data, mean, ss, var, sd, sem, tnx) If Math.Abs(var(0)) > Math.Abs(var(1)) Then top = 0 bot = 1 Else top = 1 bot = 0 End If f = var(top) / var(bot) Dim outputParameters As ParameterBag = New ParameterBag() outputParameters.AddOutput("title_0", data.Variables(top).Title) outputParameters.AddOutput("df_0", Format(tnx(top) - 1)) outputParameters.AddOutput("var_0", host.RoundU(var(top))) outputParameters.AddOutput("title_1", data.Variables(bot).Title) outputParameters.AddOutput("df_1", Format(tnx(bot) - 1)) outputParameters.AddOutput("var_1", host.RoundU(var(bot))) outputParameters.AddOutput("f", host.RoundU(f)) P = PDF.fvalp(f, CDbl(tnx(top) - 1), CDbl(tnx(bot) - 1)) outputParameters.AddOutput("p_1", host.pval(P)) If P > 0.5 Then P = 0.5 outputParameters.AddOutput("p_2", host.pval(P * 2)) If Err.Number <> 0 Then host.Error(Formatting.ERRCOLON & Err.Description, "Variance") Return outputParameters End Function
Private Sub para(ByVal Frame As DataFrame, ByRef mean() As Double, ByRef ss() As Double, ByRef var() As Double, ByRef sd() As Double, ByRef sem() As Double, ByRef tnx() As Integer) For D As Integer = 0 To Frame.VariableCount - 1 Dim nx As Integer = 0 Dim sum As Double = 0.0 Dim sumsq As Double = 0.0 For Each v As Double In Frame.Variables(D).AsDoubleVariable.Data If v <> Constant.MISSING Then nx = nx + 1 sum = sum + v sumsq = sumsq + (v * v) End If Next tnx(D) = nx mean(D) = sum / CDbl(tnx(D)) ss(D) = sumsq - ((sum * sum) / CDbl(tnx(D))) Dim sumsqdev As Double = 0.0 For Each v As Double In Frame.Variables(D).AsDoubleVariable.Data If v <> Constant.MISSING Then If Math.Abs(sumsqdev) > 1.0E+300 Then sumsqdev = Constant.MISSING Exit For End If sumsqdev = sumsqdev + (v - mean(D)) * (v - mean(D)) End If Next If sumsqdev = Constant.MISSING Then var(D) = Constant.MISSING Else var(D) = sumsqdev / CDbl(tnx(D) - 1) End If sd(D) = Math.Sqrt(var(D)) sem(D) = sd(D) / Math.Sqrt(CDbl(tnx(D))) Next End Sub
